Is your $5 latte really worth $172,000?

$5 a day is $1,825 a year. At a hypothetical 7% for 30 years, that grows to about $172,000.
But the average household spent $26,266 on housing in 2024. A 10% trim there frees up $2,627 a year.
Ground coffee went from $4.59/lb in Jan 2021 to $9.37/lb in Jan 2026.

Sources: BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey 2024, BLS average price data, David Bach (2004).
News and education, not financial advice.
